verdict.rationale:
Appwrite explicitly markets AI-native SDK usage with an official MCP server that lets LLMs call its API without managing keys, an official CLI for programmatic resource management, and dedicated llms.txt/docs.md machine-readable documentation plus a stated goal to 'teach agents your backend so they make SDK-accurate calls.' This directly supports building against official SDKs in an agentic/AI-native workflow.

missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification that agents actually produce SDK-accurate calls via these tools, and a clear listing of which language SDKs are covered by this AI-native tooling.
